# MCP TypeScript SDK dependency notice

ANKITA's explicitly started native MCP gateway uses the official
`@modelcontextprotocol/server@2.3.1` and `@modelcontextprotocol/node@2.1.1` packages.
Source: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/typescript-sdk.
The packages' licensing-transition notice and Apache-2.0/MIT terms are preserved in
`LICENSE`, copied unchanged from the reviewed installed package. No SDK source or
application assets are transplanted into ANKITA. See the lockfile for exact integrity
and transitive versions, and `docs/chatgpt-browser-verification.md` for review evidence.
